info.name: Zym Gym Backend API
info.description: Postman Collection v2.1 for the routes actually registered by server/src/app.js and the route modules. Uses cookie authentication, X-CSRF-Token, environment variables, safe-by-default local/test-database checks, and response/status tests. Read gym-backend.postman_test_plan.md before running. No requests were executed while creating this collection.

exec: const name = pm.info.requestName;
const path = pm.request.url.getPath();
const host = pm.request.url.getHost();
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Cookie', value: '' });
if (host !== 'localhost' && host !== '127.0.0.1') { console.warn('Safety gate: this collection only sends to localhost.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

if (path !== '/api/v1/health' && pm.environment.get('testDatabaseConfirmed') !== 'yes') { console.warn('Safety gate: set testDatabaseConfirmed=yes only after starting the API against a dedicated test database.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
const emailDeliveryNames = new Set(['Register Member', 'Resend OTP', 'Forgot Password', 'Admin Record Offline Payment']);

if (emailDeliveryNames.has(name) && pm.environment.get('emailSinkConfirmed') !== 'yes') { console.warn('Safety gate: configure a local email sink, then set emailSinkConfirmed=yes.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }
if (name === 'Resend Phone OTP') { console.warn('Safety gate: skipped because this route sends a WhatsApp OTP through Meta.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

if (name === 'Forgot Password') { try { const identifier = JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw).identifier; if (!String(identifier).includes('@')) { console.warn('Safety gate: phone reset could send a WhatsApp message.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); } } catch (_) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } }

if (path.startsWith('/api/v1/payments') && ['POST', 'PATCH'].includes(pm.request.method) && pm.environment.get('allowTestPaymentRecords') !== 'yes') { console.warn('Safety gate: set allowTestPaymentRecords=yes only for a dedicated disposable test database.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); }

const adminNames = new Set(['Admin Logout', 'Admin Dashboard', 'Admin List Members', 'Admin Update Member Status', 'Admin Payment Summary', 'Admin Expiring Memberships', 'Admin List Enquiries', 'Admin Update Enquiry', 'Admin List Notifications', 'Admin List Memberships', 'Admin Update Membership Status', 'Admin Create Membership Plan', 'Admin Update Membership Plan', 'Admin Deactivate Membership Plan', 'Admin Record Offline Payment', 'Admin List Payments', 'Admin Confirm Payment Again', 'Admin Refund Payment', 'Admin Create Trainer', 'Admin Update Trainer', 'Admin Deactivate Trainer', 'Admin Create Workout Plan', 'Admin Update Workout Plan', 'Admin Deactivate Workout Plan']);

const memberNames = new Set(['Member Logout', 'Get Auth Me', 'Resend Phone OTP', 'Verify Phone OTP', 'Change Password', 'Get My Profile', 'Update My Profile', 'Member Request Membership', 'Member List My Memberships', 'Member Request Renewal', 'Member List My Payments', 'Get Payment By ID', 'Member List My Workouts']);
const role = adminNames.has(name) ? 'admin' : memberNames.has(name) ? 'member' : null;

if (role) { const access = pm.environment.get(role + 'AccessToken'); const csrf = pm.environment.get(role + 'CsrfToken'); if (!access || !csrf) { console.warn('Safety gate: log in with the matching ' + role + ' test account first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); } else { pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Cookie', value: 'accessToken=' + access + '; csrfToken=' + csrf }); if (!['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(pm.request.method)) pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-CSRF-Token', value: csrf }); } }

if (name === 'Reset Password') { const reset = pm.environment.get('resetToken'); if (!reset) { console.warn('Safety gate: complete Verify Reset OTP first.'); pm.execution.skipRequest(); } else { pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Cookie', value: 'resetToken=' + reset }); } }
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'Accept', value: 'application/json' });

const expectedStatus = { 'Health Check':200, 'Register Member':201, 'Verify Email OTP':200, 'Resend OTP':200, 'Resend Phone OTP':200, 'Verify Phone OTP':200, 'Member Login':200, 'Admin Login':200, 'Member Logout':200, 'Admin Logout':200, 'Get Auth Me':200, 'Forgot Password':200, 'Verify Reset OTP':200, 'Reset Password':200, 'Change Password':200, 'Get My Profile':200, 'Update My Profile':200, 'List Membership Plans':200, 'Admin Create Membership Plan':201, 'Admin Update Membership Plan':200, 'Admin Deactivate Membership Plan':200, 'Member Request Membership':201, 'Member List My Memberships':200, 'Admin List Memberships':200, 'Admin Update Membership Status':200, 'Member Request Renewal':201, 'Admin Record Offline Payment':201, 'Member List My Payments':200, 'Admin List Payments':200, 'Get Payment By ID':200, 'Admin Confirm Payment Again':409, 'Admin Refund Payment':200, 'List Trainers':200, 'Admin Create Trainer':201, 'Admin Update Trainer':200, 'Admin Deactivate Trainer':200, 'Create Enquiry':201, 'Admin List Enquiries':200, 'Admin Update Enquiry':200, 'Member List My Workouts':200, 'Admin Create Workout Plan':201, 'Admin Update Workout Plan':200, 'Admin Deactivate Workout Plan':200, 'Admin Dashboard':200, 'Admin List Members':200, 'Admin Update Member Status':200, 'Admin Payment Summary':200, 'Admin Expiring Memberships':200, 'Admin List Admin Enquiries':200, 'Admin Update Admin Enquiry':200, 'Admin List Notifications':200, 'List Notifications':200 };
const expected = expectedStatus[pm.info.requestName];
if (expected !== undefined) pm.test('Expected HTTP ' + expected, function () { pm.response.to.have.status(expected); });

pm.test('Standard API response envelope', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(pm.response.code < 400); pm.expect(body.message).to.be.a('string'); if (body.success) pm.expect(body).to.have.property('data'); else pm.expect(body).to.have.property('errors'); });
const response = (() => { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (_) { return {}; } })();
const setCookieValues = pm.response.headers.all().filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map(h => h.value);

function setCookieEnv(cookieName, envName) { const match = setCookieValues.join('\n').match(new RegExp('(?:^|\\n)' + cookieName + '=([^;\\n]+)')); if (match) pm.environment.set(envName, decodeURIComponent(match[1])); }
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Register Member' && response.data && response.data.user) pm.environment.set('memberId', response.data.user.id);

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Member Login' && response.data && response.data.user) { pm.environment.set('memberId', response.data.user.id); setCookieEnv('accessToken', 'memberAccessToken'); setCookieEnv('csrfToken', 'memberCsrfToken'); }

if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Login' && response.data && response.data.user) { pm.environment.set('adminId', response.data.user.id); setCookieEnv('accessToken', 'adminAccessToken'); setCookieEnv('csrfToken', 'adminCsrfToken'); }
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Verify Reset OTP') setCookieEnv('resetToken', 'resetToken');
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Reset Password') pm.environment.unset('resetToken');
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Member Logout') { pm.environment.unset('memberAccessToken'); pm.environment.unset('memberCsrfToken'); }
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Logout') { pm.environment.unset('adminAccessToken'); pm.environment.unset('adminCsrfToken'); }
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Create Membership Plan' && response.data && response.data.plan) pm.environment.set('planId', response.data.plan._id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Member Request Membership' && response.data && response.data.membership) pm.environment.set('membershipId', response.data.membership._id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Member Request Renewal' && response.data && response.data.membership) pm.environment.set('renewalMembershipId', response.data.membership._id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Record Offline Payment' && response.data && response.data.payment) pm.environment.set('paymentId', response.data.payment._id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Create Enquiry' && response.data && response.data.enquiry) pm.environment.set('enquiryId', response.data.enquiry.id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Create Trainer' && response.data && response.data.trainer) pm.environment.set('trainerId', response.data.trainer._id);
if (pm.info.requestName === 'Admin Create Workout Plan' && response.data && response.data.workout) pm.environment.set('workoutId', response.data.workout._id);
